class.name: OcgBrepmeshDeflection
class.brief_description: Auxiliary tool encompassing methods to compute deflection of shapes.
class.description: ! Auxiliary tool encompassing methods to compute deflection of shapes.

method.name: ComputeAbsoluteDeflection
method.description: Returns absolute deflection for theShape with respect to the relative deflection and theMaxShapeSize.

method.name: ComputeDeflection_3
method.description: Computes and updates deflection of the given discrete edge.

method.name: ComputeDeflection_1
method.description: Computes and updates deflection of the given discrete wire.

method.name: ComputeDeflection_2
method.description: Computes and updates deflection of the given discrete face.

method.name: IsConsistent
method.description: Checks if the deflection of current polygonal representation is consistent with the required deflection.
